title: security.masking.mask_estimator
---



```python
security.masking.mask_estimator(estimator)
```

Return a non-sensitive string representation of an estimator.

Logs the estimator *type* without exposing its hyperparameters or any other
configuration. This is the safe form to emit at INFO level when the actual
estimator object may carry tuning details that should not be persisted in
log aggregation systems (CWE-532).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                | Description                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|-----------|---------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| estimator | [Any](`typing.Any`) | An estimator instance, an estimator name (string), or ``None``. When ``None``, the default project estimator label is returned. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                            |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [str](`str`) | A short, safe string identifying the estimator family. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#77b419ad .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
from spotforecast2_safe.security.masking import mask_estimator

mask_estimator(None)
```

```
'LGBMRegressor (default)'
```
:::
:::
